discovery: Development of controlled/living radical polymerization (atom transfer radical polymerization and reversible addition-fragmentation chain-transfer polymerization) for precise synthesis of functional polymers
rationale: The prize has gone to biochemistry and computation (2024) and to materials (MOFs, 2025), so the committee may now turn to synthetic polymer chemistry. Controlled radical polymerization (ATRP and RAFT) is cited very widely. It changed how polymers are designed for industry, medicine and materials, and its pioneers have collected the major precursor awards (Wolf Prize, Japan Prize) and have often been named Nobel favorites by Clarivate and other forecasters.
